title: QA_Platform_buyer_rejects_submitted_bid_while_open

title: QA_Platform_reject_without_rebidding_lists_vendor_as_blocked
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has submitted a bid; disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open).
steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid and does NOT allow re-bidding.
2. Read the round back as the buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; the round's misc.not_allow_rebidding_to_sellers now lists QA vendor 1.
rationale: The block list is what stops the vendor; the dashboard greys the vendor out from it (selectors.js:1169-1172).

plan.dependsOnSetting: disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open)

steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid and does NOT allow re-bidding.
2. QA vendor 1 tries to place a new bid.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_can_rebid_when_allowed

steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid and allows re-bidding.

expectedResult: Step 2 is accepted: the vendor's new bid is submitted (HTTP 200).
rationale: The default in the reject dialog is 'allow re-bidding'; a vendor wrongly blocked loses the event.

title: QA_Platform_rebidding_flag_as_text_false_does_not_block
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has submitted a bid; disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open).
steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid sending allow_rebidding as the text "false".
2. QA vendor 1 places a new bid.
expectedResult: Today: the vendor is NOT blocked — step 2 is accepted — because the code compares with the boolean false only.
rationale: Any caller that sends form-encoded or string booleans silently loses the block.

plan.dependsOnSetting: disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open)

act.say: The buyer rejects the bid with allow_rebidding "false" (text).

title: QA_Platform_reject_without_a_reason_is_accepted

title: QA_Platform_rejecting_the_same_bid_twice_is_refused

steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid.
2. The buyer rejects the same bid again.
expectedResult: Step 2: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' (the bid is no longer active).
rationale: A double click must not record two rejections or re-run the side effects.

plan.dependsOnSetting: disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open)

title: QA_Platform_reject_unknown_bid

expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists'.

title: QA_Platform_reject_garbled_bid_id
preconditions: A signed-in buyer.
steps: 1. Reject with an id that does not decode.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists'.
rationale: A nil id must not crash Bid.find_by_id.

title: QA_Platform_draft_bid_cannot_be_rejected
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has opened a bid but not submitted it.
steps: 1. QA vendor 1 opens a bid (draft).
2. The buyer tries to reject that draft.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — only an active (submitted) bid can be rejected.
rationale: A buyer must not be able to act on a quote the vendor has not sent.

arrange.say: QA vendor 1 opens a bid and leaves it as a draft.

title: QA_Platform_bid_can_be_rejected_after_bidding_closed
preconditions: An RFQ where QA vendor 1 bid and the bidding window (with the extra closing time) is over.
steps: 1. The buyer rejects the bid after the close.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 — rejecting during evaluation is allowed (the reject path has no time rule; the 'disable while bidding' setting only applies while the round is running).
rationale: Buyers reject non-compliant quotes at evaluation time.

title: QA_Platform_bid_on_withdrawn_event_cannot_be_rejected
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 bid; the buyer then withdraws the event.
steps: 1. The buyer withdraws the event (with a remark).
2. The buyer tries to reject the vendor's bid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — a withdrawn event's rounds are in_active.
rationale: Nothing may change on a withdrawn event.

title: QA_Platform_bid_on_submitted_award_cannot_be_rejected
preconditions: An RFQ the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted).
steps: 1. The buyer tries to reject the awarded vendor's bid.
expectedResult: Refused (HTTP 422): code 785 'Can not reject a bid which is selected for proposal' — or code 101 if the bid already left the active state when the proposal was submitted.
rationale: Rejecting a bid that is on a proposal would orphan the award.

title: QA_Platform_blocking_one_vendor_does_not_block_another

title: QA_Platform_in_active_on_live_round_is_a_silent_no_op
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 submitted a bid.
steps: 1. The buyer sets the bid's status to in_active (what the dashboard's 'remove bid' sends).
2. The buyer then rejects the same bid with the reject action.
expectedResult: Today: step 1 answers HTTP 200 but changes nothing on a live round (in_active is applied only to draft rounds), so step 2 still finds an active bid and is accepted. The dashboard shows 'bid discarded' after step 1.
rationale: A success answer for a change that never happened misleads the buyer.

plan.dependsOnSetting: disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time is OFF on the round (rejecting is allowed while bidding is open)

after.say: The buyer rejects the same bid (only possible if it is still active).

title: QA_Platform_vendor_discards_own_draft_bid

steps: 1. QA vendor 1 opens a bid.
2. QA vendor 1 discards that draft.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; the draft becomes in_active.
rationale: Vendors abandon half-filled quotes; the draft must go away cleanly.

title: QA_Platform_vendor_can_start_again_after_discarding
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has opened a bid.
steps: 1. QA vendor 1 opens a bid.
2. QA vendor 1 discards it.
3. QA vendor 1 places a full bid.

title: QA_Platform_submitted_bid_cannot_be_discarded

expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists' (only drafts are looked up).
rationale: A submitted quote must not disappear without a revoke trail.

title: QA_Platform_discarding_twice_is_refused
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has opened a bid.
steps: 1. QA vendor 1 opens a bid.
2. Discards it.
3. Discards it again.
expectedResult: Step 3: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists'.

title: QA_Platform_discarding_unknown_bid_refused
preconditions: QA vendor 1 signed in.
steps: 1. Discard a bid id that does not exist.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists'.

title: QA_Platform_other_vendor_cannot_discard_my_draft
preconditions: A live RFQ where QA vendor 1 has opened a bid; QA vendor 2 is another company.
steps: 1. QA vendor 1 opens a bid.
2. QA vendor 2 tries to discard QA vendor 1's draft.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 250 'No such bid exists' — the lookup is limited to the caller's own drafts.
rationale: One vendor must never be able to wipe another's quote.

title: QA_Platform_draft_can_be_discarded_after_close

2. Wait until the round closes.

expectedResult: Today: HTTP 200 — discarding a draft has no time rule.
rationale: Records present behaviour (harmless: a draft is not a quote).

title: QA_Platform_rejected_bids_list_answers_after_a_rejection
